# ops_project (Resource)

A project: a group of workspaces, such as an environment or a cloud subscription. Its team access, variable sets, runner pool and environment values reach all its workspaces.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A project per Azure subscription: its runs go to the runners of its pool.
resource "ops_project" "prd" {
  name        = "prd"
  description = "Production subscription"
  runner_pool = "prd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 2–63 lowercase letters, digits and dashes; its URL. Renaming keeps its workspaces.

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) New workspaces land here unless another project is picked. Setting it makes this the default project; unsetting it isn't possible (make another the default).
- `description` (String) Shown on its overview.
- `runner_pool` (String) Only runners of this pool get its workspaces' runs, and their variables. Default: `default`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project's id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by name or id
terraform import ops_project.prd prd
```
